execution.driver: Temporary define-referents-only Python orchestration script; not retained as repository source.
execution.behavior_configuration: Each executor received only the selected baseline or candidate define-referents Skill, its matching bundled reference, visible conversation, declared fixture files, and an adjacent Skill only for the named coexistence cases. A separate Codex grader received hidden assigned assertions, additional requirements, fixture hashes, command traces, and the executor response.
execution.trigger_protocol: Select from installed names and descriptions, open every selected SKILL.md with a shell command, and count only an observed Skill file read.
execution.isolation: Every invocation used an isolated HOME while retaining the existing CODEX_HOME for authentication, preventing globally installed personal Skills from being discovered.
execution.verdict_rule: Grade only assertions assigned to the case. A failed critical assertion fails the case; a partial result with no critical failure makes the case partial.
execution.raw_artifacts: Disposable fixtures, prompts, responses, JSONL, grader output, and command traces were retained only under temporary directories outside the repository.

evaluation_revisions.coverage: A two-case smoke run verified the temporary runner, matched baseline/candidate setup, two-phase grading, and low-impact no-confirmation behavior before the full suite.

The full matched run covered nine behavior cases and ten routing cases. The candidate passed 45 of 46 assigned requirements and eight cases; public-contract-alternatives was partial because its hidden requirement incorrectly required reopening the already confirmed need for two distinct facts.
